item.title: Estonia warns public to avoid DeepSeek, Qwen and Botastico AI platforms
item.description: The Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs has urged state agencies, businesses and families to stop using three artificial intelligence platforms.

item.title: Fox found at Tallinn Airport, safely returned to the wild
item.description: A fox that wandered into Tallinn Airport last week was caught by rescuers and released back into the wild.

item.title: Bean harvest nearly doubles, but most of it leaves Estonia
item.description: Estonian farmers harvested nearly 90 million kilograms of field beans this year, almost double last year's crop.

item.title: Cherry trees blossom in Tartu University Hospital courtyard
item.description: While people usually expect the first snowfall in late November, nature is doing its own thing in Tartu. Cherry trees in the courtyard of Tartu University Hospital have unexpectedly begun to bloom.

item.title: Tallinn ignores architects' proposals for major thoroughfare reconstruction
item.description: The Estonian Association of Architects has made several proposals to the City of Tallinn to modify the Pärnu maantee reconstruction project. The city, however, has not adopted the architects' suggestions.
